sections.name: オープニング：本日のテーマ紹介
sections.plan: Sakura greets the viewers, introducing the Thai Green Curry theme. She explains that it’s vibrant, aromatic, and perfect for a special meal. She gestures towards the ingredients laid out on the clean counter, building excitement for the meal.

sections.plan: Sakura starts sautéing the green curry paste in a pot, followed by coconut milk. The paste sizzles dramatically (close-ups here). She adds tofu and vegetables, bringing the curry to a simmer. The camera follows the color change and the steam rising from the pot.

sections.name: ステップ3：盛り付けと完成の確認

sections.name: エンディング：次回への予告
sections.plan: Sakura thanks the viewers and wraps up the segment, teasing the next week's delicious meal.

segments.caption: 今日のタイグリーンカレーを振り返り、視聴者に感謝を伝える。
